table.name: TLGNR_PLANT_TRACK_BS
table.description: Track at a plant. Each loadingpoint for rail refers to a track. Several loadingpoints of several shippingpoints of a plant can share the same track though. Track information + position information of the wagon on this track denote the exact location of a wagon at a plant; this information is used and updated in rail disposition.

column.name: PLANT_TRACK_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data.

column.name: PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant. Plant to which the track belongs. Several loadingpoints of different shippingpoints can share the same track (case loadingpoint bag products in Untervaz, normal+narrow gauge), therefore a track can only be owned by a plant.

column.name: TRACK_NAME
column.description: The name of the track, unique per plant. Examples: H1, H2, Z1, ...

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
